reason: Ceiling below the gate, and transfer is unproven. (1) Metric ceiling: score = sum w*J*(1-0.1*dT/T) + 0.1*divJ; relink edges are single-child, so the division term is untouched. The best measured dJ_edge is +0.0017 (Corwin arm A: 98 TP gained and 144 FP removed over 199 films, ~0.5 TP and 0.7 FP per film), times a node multiplier of ~1.05, so <= +0.0018. That was measured on an arm WITHOUT gap-close/safe-div/short-track, 0.0155 below Corwin's own champion. x138's readmit/gapfill/linefit already recover many of those ends, and our B29 LOEO put the whole motion relink at about -0.0014 adj_edge, so the mass this term can move is ~0.001-0.002. Realistic on x138: +0.0000..+0.0008, below the plan's R4 bar of +0.002 (FINAL_REPORT.md:247). An LB read of 0.954/0.955 would be uninterpretable noise that costs a slot. (2) Transfer: OOF/LOEO is out-of-fold only for the booster. The node positions and densities it scored come from a detector trained on all 199 train films (in-sample world), which is the exact mechanism behind the edge filter's +0.016 local / 0 LB (probes 29/30). The booster's strongest column, res_norm (flow residual), is what x138's flow-relink motion term already computes (x138 FLOW_MODE seed K12 R40). The remaining ambiguity columns (n_cand/rank/ratio) depend on the false-node density, which is lower in-sample than on hidden embryos, so they are the most shift-sensitive. (3) Node-count coupling: relink changes feed readmit. A 1% change in Tp is worth ~0.001 of score, as large as the whole edge gain, and its sign is unknown. (4) The owner (0.965 team) did not wire it into their kept cell06_ker11_keep.py from the same bundle, which is weak evidence that it gave nothing in their full-stack run. (5) It is functionally a learned reweighting of relink costs, close to the closed relink-knob line. exp60 cannot validate it (in-sample for both booster and detector), so the only test is a public-LB coin flip below the noise floor.
fix: Do not build or spend a slot. Revisit only if (a) Corwin or another team publishes a full-stack (gap-close + safe-div) hidden-LB delta >= +0.002 for this booster, or (b) an honest out-of-sample check exists: score the booster on relink candidates from a detector that never saw those films (friend A's scratch LOEO primary, friend_a_exp02_loeo20 trained on 6bba, applied to 44b6). It would need to show >= +0.002 score on the full x138 tail with node count within +/-0.5%. If it is ever shipped, pre-register a single coefficient of 16, pin the booster sha, and make it fail-soft with default 0.
realistic_gain: ~+0.0003 public expected (range -0.001..+0.0012 once node-count coupling is included); ceiling +0.0018 even with perfect transfer; P(>= +0.002 on the LB) ~0.05; private transfer unknown and likely lower than public given the in-sample feature distribution.
